_description: ⚠  PLACEHOLDER — replace ALL numeric values with your real training results before submission.
_dataset: EATD-Corpus (Shen et al., ICASSP 2022) — bimodal: audio + Mandarin text, SDS-derived labels (≈162 participants, class-imbalanced)
_training: CNN (audio branch), LSTM + BiLSTM (text branch), late-fusion MLP. bert-base-chinese text encoder (last 2 layers fine-tuned). 30 epochs, batch 8, LR 2e-4, AdamW.
_cross_validation: 5-fold stratified CV on train split; reported metrics are mean ± std across folds. Final model retrained on full train split.
_how_to_update: After running `python backend/train.py --mode eatd`, copy metrics from `backend/checkpoints/eatd/final_metrics.json` into this file.

dataset_notes.name: EATD-Corpus
dataset_notes.citation: Shen, Y., Yang, H., & Lin, L. (2022). Automatic Depression Detection: An Emotional Audio-Textual Corpus and a GRU/Transformer-Based Model. ICASSP 2022.
dataset_notes.class_balance: Imbalanced — majority non-depressed. Class weighting applied during training.
dataset_notes.text_tokeniser: jieba (for LSTM/BiLSTM baselines); bert-base-chinese (for BERT encoder)
dataset_notes.audio_features: Mel-spectrogram (n_mels=128, hop_length=512, n_fft=2048), MFCC-40, pitch (F0), energy, speech rate, pause ratio

limitations: Small dataset (~162 participants) — results may not generalise to broader populations.
Mandarin-only corpus — the model is not validated on other languages.
SDS-derived labels introduce labelling noise compared to clinician-administered HDRS.
Class imbalance in EATD-Corpus may inflate accuracy; F1 and ROC-AUC are the primary metrics.
Audio recorded in controlled conditions — real-world noise degrades audio-branch performance.
This system is a research prototype and NOT a clinical diagnostic tool.
